questions.title: Which driver will win the 2026 Formula One Spanish Grand Prix?
questions.background: The Spanish Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official race classification published by the FIA or Formula One. Resolution : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, scheduled for September 13, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The driver's name.
questions.current_reasoning: The September 13 Spanish Grand Prix debuts the brand-new Madrid semi-street circuit (distinct from June's Barcelona-Catalunya GP), nearly three months away. Unfamiliar track surfaces, street-circuit safety car risk, and rapid mid-season development convergence under 2026 regulations widen the distribution (top-5 sum 0.74). Mercedes leads on baseline car pace and Antonelli's Monaco street win (Antonelli 0.23, Russell 0.16), followed by Ferrari (Hamilton 0.14, street-specialist Leclerc 0.10) and improving reigning champion Lando Norris (0.11), leaving 26% for Piastri, Verstappen, and debut-venue chaos.

local_articles.title: Lando Norris beats George Russell to pole in Dutch hat-trick for McLaren
local_articles.snippet: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands, Aug 22 : Formula One champion Lando Norris beat Mercedes title contenders George Russell and Kimi Antonelli to earn McLaren a ​third successive Dutch Grand Prix pole position on Saturday. The pole, with drivers scrambling to get their laps in before forecast rain at the seaside Zandvoort circuit, was also the second in a row for Norris after he won in Hungary from the top slot before the August break. Norris now has a great chance to win on Sunday, given that the driver on pole has always won the Dutch round ever since it returned to the calendar in 2021 following a 34-year absence. Sunday’s race will be the last in that sequence, with Zandvoort’s old-school layout dropping off the calendar for the foreseeable future. local_articles.title: Lando Norris surges past Russell and Antonelli to take Dutch Grand Prix pole
local_articles.snippet: Lando Norris claimed pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix, producing a mighty lap at Zandvoort to beat the Mercedes of George Russell and Kimi Antonelli into second and third place, coming back at the last to seal the top spot against the odds. Norris’s McLaren team-mate, Oscar Piastri, was in fourth, with Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc in fifth and sixth for Ferrari and Max Verstappen in seventh for Red Bull. Norris’s pace and control was quite something, doubly so since he had railed against how much the car was struggling for pace after he managed only third in the sprint race on Saturday, which was won by Russell. Indeed, Norris described it as the “best lap of my life”, apparently in reference to how the car was not at its best. local_articles.title: Russell celebrates morale-boosting Dutch GP sprint win
local_articles.snippet: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands, Aug 22 - George Russell took a morale-boosting Dutch Grand Prix sprint race win from pole position on Saturday while Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli extended his Formula One championship lead over Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton to 53 points. Refreshed and back with a bang after the August break, Russell led every lap and took the chequered flag 1.360 seconds ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc with McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris in third place and Antonelli fourth as the rain came down just as the otherwise dry race was finishing. Hamilton, Antonelli's closest title rival after 11 grands prix and five sprint races, finished seventh behind McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in fifth and sixth. questions.title: Which official will Nigeria's interior minister suspend over the deaths of detained miners in Niger State in September 2026?
questions.background: Nigerian authorities have announced that miners died while being held in custody in Niger State.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Statements from Nigeria's Interior Ministry or reliable news reporting of the ministry's disciplinary decisions. Resolution : Identify the official suspended by the interior minister in connection with the miners' deaths in custody in Niger State. The suspension must be publicly announced by 30 September 2026; calls for disciplinary action without an announced suspension do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The suspended official's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: As of June 24, 2026, the Niger State custodial miner deaths have not yet occurred or been reported, so substantial probability (~49%) rests on an unnamed facility-level custodial officer-in-charge (e.g., Deputy Controller of a Minna/Suleja/New Bussa custodial centre), a divisional NSCDC officer, or a newly rotated state head. Among current senior officials under Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, Niger State Controller of Corrections Ogunleye Seyi Oladipupo (appointed April 15, 2026) and Niger State NSCDC Commandant Suberu Siyaka Aniviye (whose command arrested and detained 34 suspected illegal miners in Niger State in February 2026) are the two most directly exposed state-level officials. NSCDC Mining Marshals Commander Attah John Onoja (already embroiled in June 2026 enforcement controversies), NCoS Controller-General Sylvester Ndidi Nwakuche, and NSCDC Commandant-General Ahmed Abubakar Audi (reappointed February 28, 2026) hold smaller probabilities.

questions.title: Which brand will be Kylian Mbappe’s principal personal sportswear sponsor on September 18, 2026?
questions.background: Kylian Mbappe is a Real Madrid forward with a longstanding individual sponsorship agreement with Nike.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official sponsorship announcements by Mbappe or the sponsoring brand, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the brand holding Mbappe’s principal individual sportswear sponsorship as of September 18, 2026. If no sponsorship change has been announced by that date, resolve to his incumbent sponsor. Club kit suppliers and endorsements outside sportswear do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sportswear brand.
questions.current_reasoning: Kylian Mbappé's 19-year Nike deal was extended one month to July 31, 2026 for the World Cup, with L'Équipe (June 7, 2026) estimating ~50% odds of a bumper ~€20m/yr Nike renewal. Crucially, L'Équipe reported standard matching-rights rules bar Mbappé from committing elsewhere for six months after expiry—meaning if he leaves Nike, he is expected to start 2026-27 unsponsored until early 2027, which under the resolution criteria ('if no sponsorship change has been announced by September 18, resolve to incumbent') STILL resolves to Nike (~80% combined). If Nike waives the matching window early, Real Madrid supplier Adidas (9%), aggressive suitor Under Armour (4%), Puma (2%), and an outside-football brand akin to On (2%) account for most remaining mass.

questions.title: Who will top the PSA women's world squash rankings on September 21, 2026?
questions.background: The Professional Squash Association (PSA) publishes weekly world rankings for professional squash players.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official PSA women's world rankings dated September 21, 2026. Resolution : Resolve to the player ranked first in that rankings update. Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: On June 20, 2026, World No. 1 Hania El Hammamy won the season-ending PSA Squash Tour Finals in Paris (her seventh title of 2025/26), widening her lead over 18-year-old World No. 2 Amina Orfi (2026 World Champion & British Open winner), who fell in the semifinals. With July-August being the PSA off-season and only ~1 major season-opening event (typically mid-September's Egyptian Open) before the September 21 rankings update, El Hammamy is a strong favorite to retain #1. Orfi retains a clear ~23% chance to overtake her if she wins the September Diamond event while El Hammamy exits early or defends heavy September 2025 points, with World No. 3 Nour El Sherbini and absent former #1 Nouran Gohar distant longshots.

questions.title: Which Republican U.S. senator will formally request that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business dealings in September 2026?
questions.background: Donald Trump Jr. is President Donald Trump’s eldest son. Congressional investigations can examine potential conflicts of interest involving a president’s family members.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public congressional correspondence or reliable contemporaneous news reporting identifying the senator making the request. Qualifying Event : A Republican U.S. senator formally requests during September 2026 that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business relationships. Accepted Answer Format : The senator’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Senate Democrats renewed demands on June 23, 2026 for hearings into the $500M UAE/Sheikh Tahnoon investment in Trump-family crypto venture World Liberty Financial (co-founded by Donald Trump Jr.), which Judiciary Chairman Chuck Grassley immediately dismissed, while GOP Senate tensions boiled over on June 23-24 when four Republicans (Bill Cassidy, Rand Paul, Lisa Murkowski, Susan Collins) backed an Iran War Powers resolution and primary-defeated lame duck Cassidy confronted Trump directly. Retiring Judiciary Committee member Thom Tillis (17%) leads given his direct committee seat, vocal friction with the administration, and freedom from primary risk, closely followed by independent oversight hawk Rand Paul (15%), perennial maverick Lisa Murkowski (13%), embattled lame-duck rebel Bill Cassidy (12%), and general-election-facing Susan Collins (10%) ahead of the November 2026 midterms. A substantial 33% remains on other GOP senators, notably primary-defeated Judiciary member John Cornyn, Josh Hawley, Mitch McConnell, John Curtis, and Todd Young.

questions.title: Who will win the women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen?
questions.background: The World Athletics Road Running Championships award an individual world title in the women's half marathon.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official World Athletics race results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the individual women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen when the race results are announced. The team competition does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning athlete's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: While USATF (led by Weini Kelati) and GB have named rosters for the Sept 20 World Road Running Championships in Copenhagen, powerhouse federations Kenya and Ethiopia—which dominate global half marathon titles—have not yet selected their squads. Road 10K WR holder Agnes Jebet Ngetich (63:04 HM PB), 3-time World Half champion Peres Jepchirchir (who may instead prioritize an autumn Major marathon), Fotyen Tesfay (63:21), Lilian Kasait Rengeruk (63:32), and Tsigie Gebreselama headline likely contenders, while Beatrice Chebet is focused on track/Budapest 5,000m a week earlier. Given unannounced East African rosters and deep Kenyan/Ethiopian talent pools, top-5 sum is calibrated at 38%.

questions.title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
questions.background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results. Resolution : Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The party's name or its standard abbreviation.
questions.current_reasoning: Three months before Berlin's September 20, 2026 Abgeordnetenhaus election, the Tagesspiegel June 15 poll average puts Governing Mayor Kai Wegner's CDU first at 21.7%, followed closely by AfD (17.9%), Bündnis 90/Die Grünen (16.8%), Die Linke (15.1%), and SPD (14.3%), with FDP (4%) and BSW (3.1%) below the 5% threshold. While CDU leads every recent poll (22% Civey June 15, 20% INSA May 16, 19% Infratest dimap April 29), its lead over second place ranges from just 1 to 4 points—well within typical three-month German state polling error—giving AfD, the Greens, and Die Linke (which topped Berlin in the 2025 federal election) genuine paths to finish first.

questions.title: Which sector will show the largest year-on-year percentage decline in Iran's official GDP report for March 21–June 20, 2026?
questions.background: Iran is at war with the United States and Israel.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Statistical Center of Iran's GDP figures for March 21–June 20, 2026, publicly reported by September 21, 2026. The answer is the economic sector with the greatest year-on-year percentage contraction among the sectors reported. Resolution Date : 2026-09-21 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the sector's conventional name.
questions.current_reasoning: Iran's Q1 1405 (March 21–June 20, 2026) coincided entirely with the US-Israel-Iran war, including the Strait of Hormuz shutdown and the US naval blockade of all Iranian ports beginning April 2026, making Oil and gas (SCI's crude oil and natural gas extraction sector, which grew +1.8% in pre-war 1404) the leading candidate for the steepest year-on-year plunge. Water and electricity is a strong second because it was already SCI's worst-contracting sector in 1404 (-6.5%, and -8.4% in H1 1404) prior to wartime infrastructure disruption. Construction, Industry (hit by a 20% import collapse and blackouts), and Agriculture (-2.9% in 1404 amid severe drought) cover the other standard SCI reporting sectors.
